svg.title: redbeast: blink the infrared sky
svg.desc: Two real SPHEREx frames of Barnard’s Star from the NASA/IPAC IRSA archive, taken on 2025-08-25 and 2026-09-22, alternate like a blink comparator; the star shifts by 2.04 pixels in 393 days. Quantum Fit, NASA Space Apps 2026, Planet X and SPHEREx challenge.
